hooks.name: health-before-stop
hooks.description: Run npm run health in game/ when the agent tries to stop; if red, keep it working with the reason 'health is red' (KDEV-03, D-161)

action.command: cd game && if npm run health >/tmp/kiro-health.log 2>&1; then echo "$(date -Is) stop HEALTH GREEN" >> ../.kiro/hooks.log; echo 'health is green'; else echo "$(date -Is) stop HEALTH RED" >> ../.kiro/hooks.log; tail -n 40 /tmp/kiro-health.log >&2; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"health is red"}'; echo 'health is red' >&2; exit 1; fi
